# v7.0.1 — Module 7 release-state synchronization

This patch aligns the public Module 7 status and durable validation controls with the completed v7.0.0 release.

## Included

- records completed owner approval, merge, and release publication
- removes obsolete release-candidate language from the Module 7 overview and roadmap
- prevents the integration script from restoring pre-release wording
- validates citation metadata against the latest semantic-versioned release manifest and changelog date

No substantive learning content, diagrams, datasets, assessments, or calculation results change in this patch.
